scripts.check:moon: moon run tools/prepare-dependencies.mbtx && moon check --target wasm-gc --deny-warn
scripts.build:moon: moon run tools/prepare-dependencies.mbtx && moon build --target wasm-gc --release --deny-warn
scripts.build: bun run build:moon && moon run tools/build-packages.mbtx && bun run build:example
scripts.format: moon fmt && moon fmt tools/prepare-dependencies.mbtx && moon fmt tools/build-packages.mbtx && moon fmt tools/build-example.mbtx && prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .vscode packages examples
scripts.format:check: moon fmt --check && moon fmt --check tools/prepare-dependencies.mbtx && moon fmt --check tools/build-packages.mbtx && moon fmt --check tools/build-example.mbtx && prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .vscode packages examples
scripts.check: bun run check:moon && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.test: test -f test-lab/package.json && cd test-lab && bun run test
